title: Morphics Spectrum Drop (rare drop from wild enemies only)

source.description: Spectrums drop only from regular enemies found in the wild, never from bosses.

match.description: The entry matches the color of the enemy's subcategory. Every size under that subcategory drops the same Spectrum.

spectrum.description: A color in data/spectrums.json. Wild enemies of a subcategory with this color drop it. Enemies never drop another color.

chance.description: Drop chance per defeated enemy. Rare: at most 10 percent. PLACEHOLDER, set by playtest.
